dsh-observe is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Exports the session event stream to OpenTelemetry OTLP and Langfuse as sanitized, buffered traces and metrics, off by default.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ff173bb22609e9f90510.html
